dataset: OpenNeuro ds001226 sub-CON03 preop; actual fixed inputs and 5 FNIT tracking seeds

metric_policy.edges: strict upper triangle, excluding diagonal; diagonal errors reported separately
metric_policy.length_and_fa: value metrics only on common nonzero count edges
metric_policy.normalization: first matrix is the reference; cross pairs start with official, unordered within-arm pairs use supplied directory order
metric_policy.acceptance: errors <= maximum observed official-pair error; similarities >= minimum observed official-pair similarity
metric_policy.undefined: null and not_assessed, never zero or a pass
metric_policy.scope: matrix repeat envelope; not a proof of identical random streams or anatomical pipeline equivalence
metric_policy.sampling: finite observed repeat range, not a population confidence interval; criterion is fixed before examining real cross results
metric_policy.independence: caller-declared repeats; unique resolved directories and supplied seed labels are checked, but different directories alone do not prove independent execution
metric_policy.relative_l1: sum absolute error / sum absolute first matrix upper-triangle values
metric_policy.common_normalized_mae: MAE on common count edges / mean absolute first matrix value on those edges
